summary: Triển khai điều khiển Tailscale mã nguồn mở, cho phép mạng VPN dựa trên WireGuard tự chủ với quản lý kiểm soát tập trung.
usecases: Internal corporate mesh VPN without relying on Tailscale's hosted service.
Secure device connectivity for IoT and remote work environments.
Custom authentication and authorization over a self-hosted control plane.
ideas: Pair with sing-box for a full custom proxy+VPN solution.
Deploy on edge locations for geo-distributed low-latency connectivity.
Use as a base for building custom secure access platforms.
